changes.summary: Every page now wears one icon wherever it's linked: the menu, search, page cards, draft and Front Office tabs and homepage tiles all match.
Every page now wears one icon wherever it's linked: the menu, search, page cards, draft and Front Office tabs and homepage tiles all match.
Live Scoring now prints NFL kickoff times in the clock you picked in Preferences, on the games rail and the player rows, instead of always Eastern.
Live Scoring now prints NFL kickoff times in the clock you picked in Preferences, on the games rail and the player rows, instead of always Eastern.
Tip Schefter now sits first in the header's icon row, one tap from any page.
On a phone, the homepage shows the Schefter Report right under the hero, then your team and the standings. The Owners' Poll card is gone; the weekly pop-up stays.
The Broadcast has a home in MFL Live at /live/broadcast, with a live preview, one-tap full screen and TV pairing by QR code.
changes.headline: Put your Sunday on the TV
changes.lede: The Broadcast now lives in MFL Live. Watch every league's scores in a live preview, go full screen in one tap, or pair a TV by scanning a QR code with your phone.
changes.imageAlt: The MFL Live Broadcast page, with the live scoreboard playing inside a TV frame beside the Go full screen button.
